items: CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.6): Prepares ₦987.81Bn 2027 Budget for defence, Woos Blue Economy Investors & Extends Relief to 22 SPAR Mall Businesses
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.3): Graduates 350+ Operation Rainbow Operatives with Gun Trucks & Signs Jos-Kano/Jos-Owerri Flight MOU
ABIA STATE (PSI 9.1): Gov. Otti Outlines 4.5-Year Consolidation Agenda, Decouples 8 LGAs from NERC Grid & Addresses Dominion City Conference
NIGER STATE (PSI 8.8): Gov. Bago Secures 5 IsDB Smart Boarding Schools Under $110M SmartEdu Transformation Project
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.6): Partners Ogun on Traditional Medicine Regulation & Hosts SMEDAN National MSME Conference 2026
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Fintiri Inspects Yola Stadium Reconstruction, Guarantees Project Delivery Before May 2027
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. Lawal Approves 250 Teacher Trainings, Renovation of 6 Secondary Schools & Curriculum Rollout
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.0): Clarifies NYSC Orientation Camp Logistics, Highlights ₦50k Corps Grant & Partners Lagos on Health Rules
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.8): Steps Down Grassroots Paralegal Training for 100+ Community Women on Rights & Conflict Resolution

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.6): Cross River Assembly prepares ₦987.81bn 2027 budget proposal (71.72% capital) for defence, Gov Otu pitched blue economy investments at the Governor's Ball, extended ₦100m+ relief to 22 SPAR Mall fire victims, inaugurated an Ultramodern Market monitoring committee, and backed GP Land governance.

PLATEAU (PSI 9.3): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang graduated 350+ retrained Operation Rainbow operatives equipped with gun trucks, motorcycles, and 11 local activity camps; the state signed an MOU with United Nigeria Airlines for twice-weekly Jos-Kano and Jos-Owerri flights starting Nov 15.

ABIA (PSI 9.1): Gov. Alex Otti announced a 4.5-year consolidation plan at Dominion City Conference in Aba, revealing the state decoupled its remaining 8 LGAs from NERC regulation to enforce subnational power autonomy, while reiterating merit-based governance.

NIGER (PSI 8.8): Gov. Mohammed Umaru Bago hosted an IsDB preparation delegation led by Imtiaz Alam, securing 5 smart boarding schools under the $110m SmartEdu project alongside updates on 75% completed Minna-Bida road and solar projects.

LAGOS (PSI 8.6): Lagos State Traditional Medicine Board hosted Ogun State counterpart to share regulatory framework across 9,645 practitioners; Gov. Sanwo-Olu opened the SMEDAN National MSME Conference 2026 in Lagos.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.3): Gov. Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri inspected the Yola Stadium reconstruction, confirming arena completion by Dec 2026 and parking works by Jan 2027 while assuring all state projects will be delivered before May 2027.

ZAMFARA (PSI 8.2): Gov. Dauda Lawal approved capacity-building training for 250 teachers, infrastructure renovation of 6 secondary schools (including GGSS Kotorkoshi and GTC Kaura Namoda), and state-wide curriculum materials distribution.

OGUN (PSI 8.0): Ogun State clarified camp registration logistics for 4,300+ corps members while highlighting state provision of 800 mattresses and ₦50,000 welfare grants; Ogun Alternative Medicine Board visited Lagos to study traditional medicine regulation.

GOMBE (PSI 7.8): Over 100 community women in Sabon Tasha received paralegal step-down training on domestic violence prevention, women's rights, and peaceful conflict resolution in partnership with the German Embassy and Interfaith Mediation Centre.
